intro.title: Complete Your Payment
intro.description: Use the following payment information to complete your reservation before the payment deadline ends.

instructions.demoBanner: Payment simulation. The VA number is a sample. No reservation or transaction is created; do not transfer to this number.

account.title: BCA Virtual Account
account.subtitle: Automatic 24-hour real-time verification
account.calloutText: Pay the exact amount shown down to the last digit so the payment can be verified automatically without manual confirmation when the payment system is active.

guides.title: Payment Method Guide
guides.subtitle: Choose the transfer method you use below

mbca.title: BCA Mobile (m-BCA)
mbca.step1: Open the BCA Mobile app, select m-BCA and enter your Access Code.
mbca.step2: Select the m-Transfer menu > BCA Virtual Account.
mbca.step3: Enter the 16-digit Virtual Account Number: {account} then select Send.
mbca.step4: Check the name {name} and total bill {total} on the confirmation screen.
mbca.step5: Enter your m-BCA PIN to complete payment when the official service is available.

klikbca.title: KlikBCA (Internet Banking)
klikbca.step2: Select Fund Transfer > Transfer to BCA Virtual Account.
klikbca.step3: Enter the Virtual Account number {account}, then select Continue.
klikbca.step4: Check the recipient's name and the amount {total}.
klikbca.step5: Follow the KeyBCA instructions on screen to complete the transaction.

atmbca.title: BCA ATM
atmbca.step1: Insert your BCA ATM card and PIN.
atmbca.step2: Select Other Transactions > Transfer > to a BCA Virtual Account.
atmbca.step4: Check the name and amount {total}, then follow the instructions on the ATM machine.

otherBank.title: Transfer from Another Bank (ATM Bersama / Prima / ALTO)
otherBank.step1: Availability of transfers from other banks follows the terms of the official issued Virtual Account.
otherBank.step2: In this demo, interbank transfers are not yet available. Use the hotel's official instructions when the payment service is active.
